youtube_title: Can't Walk 2 Days After Leg Day? This Is Normal | Body Fix #34 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #34. Leg day on day one, and now stairs feel like a WAR?
B is right. NORMAL muscle soreness, called DOMS. Peaks in 1-3 days.
New or harder workout = tiny strain. Your body repairs it, and you get stronger.
Fix: Don't lie in bed: move lightly. Enough protein, sleep, increase load slowly.
Red flags: Sudden sharp pain, swelling, joint won't move, very dark pee? DOCTOR now.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: ACSM / NHS - DOMS
